Some of the ark's animals are read as destined for the altar, so the intake spec is also an offering-fitness…

The commanded verb executed: ASEH ('make') answered by VA-YAAS ('and he made') — the echo-class receipt (gen_09: the demand's own verb returns as the deed's).

The SECOND human-built WORLD install — and the first RECEIPTED COMPLETE: gen_13's city was a participle (building, never finished, named for a son); the ark closes its build to-spec and takes no name at all. The corpus's two human constructions: a monument that never ends, a rescue that does.

Demand two POPPED by the same formula — KEN ASAH ('so he did'): the make-verb doubled around the verse, closing both imperatives at once ('ALL that God commanded' covers the pantry with the hull). SPECS ends EMPTY: the first fully-settled divine-to-human command cycle in the corpus — pushed and paid inside one unit.
